maintenance_led.reason: Galvanizing and coil coating applied mainly to newly fabricated steel and new manufactured products, not repair of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private fabricators, manufacturers and builders; coil coating serves building products and appliances; some infrastructure exposure but not most.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through galvanizing and coil coating operations; Precoat Metals was one large deal, with only occasional other acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Coating services are fairly replaceable; customers can use other galvanizers or coaters, though specifications and logistics add some friction.

notes: Larger part is Metal Coatings (galvanizing); Precoat Metals is the other major segment.
